bioconda.name: brucellaid
bioconda.summary: Identify the Brucella species of a read set with MASH, and type it with MLST
bioconda.description:
BrucellaID reads a fastq sample, compares it with MASH to 429 curated Brucella reference genomes
covering all 30 named species of the clade to name the species and the closest reference, and calls the
nine alleles of the Whatmore MLST scheme with Seal from
BBTools to give the sequence type. It takes single-end or paired-end reads, or a folder of samples, and
writes a table per sample, a table per locus, every MASH distance, a JSON report, a MultiQC file and a
self-contained HTML quality assurance report holding the evidence behind every call. Where two species
are too close for the distance to separate them, the sequence type decides. The reference sketch and
the MLST database are shipped with the package.

commands: python -c "from brucellaid.references import load_references; assert len(load_references()) == 429"
python -c "from brucellaid.references import VSNP_REFERENCES_FILE, data_path, load_references; assert len(load_references(data_path(VSNP_REFERENCES_FILE))) == 16"
python -c "from brucellaid.mlst import load_profiles; assert len(load_profiles()[1]) == 122"
